meta.description: Find jobs, review each one and send applications in batches, only for the ones you approved.

home.title: Apply to <destaque>many jobs at once</destaque>, without losing control
home.lead: You find the jobs, review each one and approve it. W2Talent sends a batch with only the ones you approved, plus a profile summary a recruiter understands in seconds.
home.step1Text: Type it the way you'd say it: “remote DevOps contractor 15k”. The AI shows what it understood and you adjust.
home.step2Text: Each job shows how well it matches your profile and what's missing, before you decide.
home.step3Text: Only what you approved goes out. If the job changes later, the approval is dropped.
home.step4Text: Up to 10 per batch and 30 per day. Jobs already sent are marked and never sent again.
home.recruitersText: Candidates arrive with the W2 Profile: a standard summary with the required fields filled in and the match explained. Post a job by pasting its text; the AI organizes the fields and warns you if it already exists.
home.faq1q: Do I have to pay to apply?
home.faq1a: No. Candidates use it for free.
home.faq2q: Are my phone and email exposed?
home.faq2a: No. Your contact stays protected until you reply to a company.
home.faq3a: Yes. The same account works on computer and phone, and you can install it as an app.
home.faq4a: Not yet. This is the test version, and it changes often.
